question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The place where soldiers live
solution:
The correct answer is: **Barracks**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Barracks"** refers to buildings or structures where soldiers live and are housed. (सैनिकों के रहने का स्थान)

 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers returned to their barracks after completing the training exercises.
 
 
 
• **"Unit" **refers to an individual component of a larger structure or system, often used in the context of military to describe a group of soldiers organized for a particular purpose. (इकाई)
 
 
• **Example: **Each unit of the army has its own specific duties and responsibilities.
 
 
 
• **"Regiment" **is a military unit consisting of several battalions, often commanded by a colonel. (रेजिमेंट)
 
 
• **Example: **The regiment was deployed to the front lines during the conflict.
 
 
 
• **"Brigade" **is a large military unit consisting of multiple regiments or battalions, usually commanded by a brigadier general. (ब्रिगेड)
 
 
• **Example: **The brigade marched through the city as part of the parade.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Barracks**.
